latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of WhatsApp Business Responder for Indian small businesses.
- Automatically classifies incoming WhatsApp messages (orders, complaints, bookings, price queries).
- Sends auto-responses using customizable templates and basic Hindi/Hinglish detection.
- Escalates complex queries and complaints to the business owner with ticket tracking.
- Includes business profile config, ticket memory, outside-hours logic, and daily summary.
- Owner commands for template management, ticket resolution, and responder control.
